sub_fields.label: Font Family
sub_fields.name: font_family
sub_fields.instructions: Choose an existing font file bundled with this theme.

sub_fields.label: Font Category
sub_fields.name: font_category
sub_fields.instructions: Used by the Filter Section. Leave empty to use the default category for the selected font.

sub_fields.label: Background Image
sub_fields.name: background_image
sub_fields.instructions: Optional texture or background image for the font card.

sub_fields.label: Font Boxes
sub_fields.name: fonts
sub_fields.instructions: Leave empty to show the six default fonts. Add rows to customize the font names and filter categories.

sub_fields.label: Font
sub_fields.name: font_family
sub_fields.instructions: Select the font used for the font name and its sample.

sub_fields.label: Font Category
sub_fields.name: font_category
sub_fields.instructions: Used by the Filter Section and preview fallback styles.

sub_fields.label: Background Video
sub_fields.name: background_video
sub_fields.instructions: Upload an MP4 or WebM video.

sub_fields.label: Font Categories
sub_fields.name: filter_categories
sub_fields.instructions: Leave empty to use the default categories: Cursive, Display, Monospace, Sans Serif, Serif, and Slab.

sub_fields.label: Filter Value
sub_fields.name: value
sub_fields.instructions: Use the same value in the matching result's data-font-category attribute.

sub_fields.label: Default Text
sub_fields.name: default_text
sub_fields.instructions: Optional text to display in the font cards when the page loads.
